Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 29: the slip of [[No Bargain (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on your [Reflections 2] objective; "Xizor" on it (and on Guri) is treated as "Shada." Non-[Permanent Weapon] alien females are Mistryl and Black Sun agents. You may not deploy cards with ability except Mistryl and [Independent Starship] starships. Mistryl (except Kitik) are power +1 (+2 if unique (•)) and, while Scum And Villainy on table, deploy +1. [Immune to Alter]”), word for word the text of [[No Bargain (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
